comment: QUESTS.md E18, ROL-2 Roland's Own Quest. The snug's card: nothing before ROL-1, RESERVED without Roland, the prophecy on its back with him, Not today and then Today; the cave in Carn Drey, walked onto, waiting without him, Not yet, Go down; the Worm before the sword; the stone, walked to, drawn; the Worm without him; a look at the fight; lost, then won with Piper; out by the stairs; the plate and the card afterwards; and at the tower door, both swords on the grass.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._stories = $gameVariables.value(15); window._gold = $gameParty.gold(); window._lines = []; }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }; window._troops = []; window._auto = 'win'; const ss = Scene_Battle.prototype.start; Scene_Battle.prototype.start = function () { ss.call(this); this._bf = 0; window._troops.push($gameTroop._troopId); }; const su = Scene_Battle.prototype.update; Scene_Battle.prototype.update = function () { su.call(this); if (++this._bf === 60) { if (window._auto === 'win') $gameTroop.members().forEach(e => e.addState(1)); else if (window._auto === 'lose') $gameParty.members().forEach(a => a.addState(1)); } }
